description:
## Goal

Strengthen the retained LoweredBody into one immutable source-built operation/value/control denotation. Delete InputFlowRelation reconstruction and expansion once demand consumers use exact body references and views. The semantic CFG is data, never a second scheduler.

## Signal and proven defect

At the clean predecessor faeb9d669, InputFlowRelation independently reconstructs and flattens source operations. Coherent predecessor tuples and crossed tuples collapse; constants, opaque operand identity, dynamic bit-size operands, captures, multiple outputs and control restrictions can disappear. AssertSame is eagerly substituted into value definitions, even though it is a predicate. LoweredBodyMap also replaces equal payload allocations. These defects are pinned at the production World publication boundary before implementation.

## Retained model

- LoweredBody remains the sole typed operation and control vocabulary and immutable retained payload. There is no parallel SemanticBody, semantic-expression tree, expanded frame relation, or condition-alternative store.
- Body references are qualified by FunctionId and the borrowed immutable snapshot. Value/control/operation references cannot resolve against a different function or replacement snapshot. Every actual operation occurs once with ordered operand roles and every output; equal dependency descriptions never prove value identity.
- Ref-only indexes locate definitions, uses, calls and control predecessors. They contain addresses into the retained body, never copied operation, predicate or value meaning. Calls, captures, returns, equality predicates and other uses resolve the same value references.
- Each incoming control edge supplies one whole ordered parameter tuple. A tuple remains associated with its exact source edge; independent phi-column substitution cannot invent crossed combinations.
- Typed evidence references point to the existing If, Dispatch, Receive and assertion vocabulary. Success and failure remain explicit, including discarded delivery, AssertSame followed by constant return, and Halt. No eager equality substitution or control-path expansion occurs.
- Publication work and retained indexes are linear in source graph size, including independent branch chains. Effects and nondeterministic occurrences retain distinct operation identity.
- EntryDispatch and StaticCallees remain precise independent World facts/views. They are consumed at their legitimate dependency boundaries, never copied into another retained semantic language.
- The current coarse InputDemand projects through borrowed references with its existing sound coarse domain. fz-kdt.200 owns normalized relational questions, location-domain mathematics and exact substitution; fz-kdt.213 owns reactive per-function demand. Neither may recover identity or control coherence lost by this boundary.

## Equality and diagnostic ownership

Typed alpha comparison has an explicit bounded contract: operation kind and ordered semantic fields, result/operand sharing, exact edge tuples and typed predicate structure are compared under bijective local value/control renaming. Spans, display strings and raw arena order are not semantic authority. This is structural alpha equivalence, not arbitrary program equivalence or equality of opaque dependency sets.

The current LoweredBody payload still owns diagnostic spans. Equal publication therefore retains the old Rc/allocation and revision only when the complete currently-owned payload, including provenance, reproduces equal; it wakes nobody and makes no deep payload copy. Alpha-semantic comparison must NOT suppress a publication with changed provenance or leave stale diagnostics.

fz-tfn.40 and fz-tfn.57 own physical content/provenance separation and atomic source replacement. Location-only replacement may still move this boundary until they land. fz-tfn.45 owns generated callable identity across replacement, fz-tfn.20 owns source reclamation, and fz-kdt.219 owns span-stable external canonical rendering. This ticket does not claim those acceptance criteria or native incrementality; fz-tfn.13 owns semantic native-body products and code-generation reuse.

## TDD and acceptance

Demonstrate RED at clean predecessor production boundaries, then prove:

1. Coherent versus crossed join tuples remain distinct, with no Cartesian alternative expansion.
2. AssertSame(a,0) plus consume(a) differs from consume(b) when opaque a and b have the same dependencies. Repeated operands share refs; distinct operations remain distinct.
3. Unused delivery retains its control restriction. If and typed dispatch/receive success/failure evidence remains accessible at source, including Halt.
4. Every operation retains all ordered inputs/results: SplitList, BitstringRead, dynamic bit sizes, captures, calls and returns. Dynamic bit size through bits, a captured closure and direct call works on interp/run/build.
5. Same-callee callsites and their results remain isolated. Handle/control renumbering preserves typed alpha meaning.
6. n independent branches retain a linear source graph and ref index, never expanded paths/frames/conditions. Consumers contain refs only and reuse source meaning.
7. Equal complete publication retains allocation/revision, wakes nobody and does not deep-copy the body.

Continuously delete superseded InputFlowRelation types, producer/store, alias closure, lineage expansion, duplicate generic operand/result scans, proof-only probes, obsolete tests, telemetry and documentation. Keep policy-specific semantic typing, codegen and runtime demand analysis in their owning modules. Reuse existing operation and dispatch vocabulary; no opcode-string classifier, second semantic body, private CFG scheduler, migration adapter, or construction scaffold remains.

Focused production witnesses; relevant serial library/fixture matrix; all three doors; deterministic/work-count gates; current docs; cargo check; strict clippy; formatting and diff checks pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial reviewer examines the frozen candidate before its one commit and close. No deferral or omission without prior authorization.

## Ordering

fz-kdt.220 blocks fz-kdt.200, fz-kdt.213 and fz-tfn.13 as already recorded. fz-kdt.200 owns relational question/domain math. fz-kdt.213 must prove grounded recursive retraction through a generic scheduler mechanism: A = seed union B, B = A, then remove seed. Ordinary monotone peer publication alone cannot discharge this law; no InputDemand-specific SCC mini-compiler is permitted. No new ticket or dependency is needed for the validated split.
title: Retain one immutable source operation/value/control body
